# Run these in order on one UTC day using a new database file.
# Set NEWS_API_KEY locally first. Do not delete an existing database to run this test.
# Re-running this file with an already-populated database changes expected sources.

# Expected: API (up to 5 articles)
go run . -db data/cache-demo.db -query "artificial intelligence" -days 2 -limit 5

# Expected: Database, zero API calls
go run . -db data/cache-demo.db -query "artificial intelligence" -days 2 -limit 5

# Expected: Database, zero API calls, up to 3 articles
go run . -db data/cache-demo.db -query "artificial intelligence" -days 2 -limit 3

# Expected: API because requested limit increased
go run . -db data/cache-demo.db -query "artificial intelligence" -days 2 -limit 8

# Expected: API because period increased
go run . -db data/cache-demo.db -query "artificial intelligence" -days 3 -limit 8
